seo.title: Dallas Homeless Help - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified shelter, food, hygiene, health, benefits, employment, legal, and safety resources for people experiencing homelessness in Dallas.

page.heading: DALLAS - HOMELESS HELP
page.urgent: Immediate danger or life-threatening emergency: 911. Shelter and homelessness resources: 888-411-6802. City non-emergency help: 311.
page.notice: Availability and eligibility can change. Call ahead when possible. A listing does not guarantee a bed, meal, appointment, benefit, job, or legal representation.
page.intro: If you need a safe place tonight, call the Housing Forward Crisis Helpline or contact The Bridge or Austin Street Center. Bed availability is not guaranteed.
page.footer: Availability, hours, and eligibility can change. Call ahead when possible. Report incorrect information through the GitHub link in the footer.

entries.title: Emergency services — 911
entries.description: Call 911 for immediate danger, fire, a life-threatening medical emergency, or a violent situation.
entries.how_to_access: Give the exact location and describe what is happening.

entries.title: Housing Forward Crisis Helpline
entries.description: Connects people experiencing homelessness with shelter, street outreach, housing support, and community resources. It is not an emergency line and does not guarantee a bed.
entries.hours: 24-hour coverage is indicated by city shelter guidance
entries.how_to_access: Call and explain who needs help, current location, household type, and whether there are urgent health or safety needs.

entries.title: The Bridge Homeless Recovery Center
entries.description: Free day and night shelter for adults age 18 or older experiencing homelessness. No government ID, background check, or sobriety check is required for intake. Space is not guaranteed. Guest intake: 214-670-1507.
entries.hours: Night shelter 5:00 PM–6:00 AM; day services 6:00 AM–5:00 PM
entries.how_to_access: Go to intake or call 214-670-1507. Ask about current bed availability.

entries.title: Austin Street Center
entries.description: Emergency shelter and housing-focused services for people living outside or in an unsafe environment. Eligibility and space vary; call before traveling.
entries.how_to_access: Call for current intake rules, eligible groups, and bed availability.

entries.title: The Bridge — meals
entries.description: Free meals for adult guests experiencing homelessness. The official site lists breakfast, lunch, and dinner; schedules can change.
entries.hours: Day services 6:00 AM–5:00 PM; night services 5:00 PM–6:00 AM
entries.how_to_access: Go through guest intake. No ID is required for intake.

entries.title: OurCalling — breakfast and lunch
entries.description: Faith-based daytime outreach center serving a light breakfast and lunch to people sleeping outside. It is not an overnight shelter and does not distribute food boxes.
entries.address: 1702 S. Cesar Chavez Boulevard, Dallas, TX 75215
entries.how_to_access: Arrive during open hours and ask staff about that day's meal schedule.

entries.title: OurCalling
entries.description: Christian faith-based daytime outreach center for people sleeping outside. It offers meals, showers, laundry, care navigation, and placement referrals. It is not an overnight shelter. Ask staff about any religious activities and whether participation is optional.
entries.address: 1702 S. Cesar Chavez Boulevard, Dallas, TX 75215
entries.how_to_access: Walk in during open hours or call the hotline.

entries.title: The Bridge — showers and laundry
entries.description: Free showers, laundry, meals, storage, mail, phones, case management, and other services for homeless adults.
entries.how_to_access: Complete guest intake. No ID is required.

entries.title: OurCalling — showers and laundry
entries.description: Showers and laundry are available on a limited schedule. Sign-up begins at 7:00 AM and capacity can fill. The official page says each service may be used every seven days.
entries.address: 1702 S. Cesar Chavez Boulevard, Dallas, TX 75215
entries.hours: Shower sign-up 7:00 AM; showers 7:00 AM–1:00 PM; laundry walk-up 7:45–11:00 AM
entries.how_to_access: Arrive early. Ask staff for the current sign-up process.

entries.title: The Bridge — health connections
entries.description: The Bridge provides access to physical-care partners and care management for homeless adults. Services and clinic availability vary; call or ask at intake. Call 911 for a medical emergency.
entries.hours: Open 24/7; individual health services have their own schedules
entries.how_to_access: Complete guest intake and ask for physical health care.

entries.title: Metrocare homeless mental-health outreach
entries.description: Mental health and substance-use outreach and clinics for adults experiencing homelessness. Housing placement is through coordinated access; people cannot apply directly to Metrocare housing. Clinics operate at The Bridge and several other shelters.
entries.hours: The Bridge clinic: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–12:00 PM and 1:00–5:00 PM
entries.how_to_access: Visit a listed outreach clinic. For housing-resource screening, call 888-411-6802.

entries.title: The Bridge — day shelter
entries.description: A safe daytime space with restrooms, showers, laundry, meals, storage, mail, phones, computers, case management, and connections to services.
entries.how_to_access: Adults experiencing homelessness can complete intake without ID.

entries.title: The Bridge — phones and computer access
entries.description: The official service list includes phones, a library, and computer access for adult guests experiencing homelessness. Availability can vary.
entries.how_to_access: Complete intake and ask staff about phone charging and computer use.

entries.title: Your Texas Benefits and 2-1-1 Texas
entries.description: Apply for or manage SNAP food benefits, Medicaid, TANF, and other Texas benefits. Calling 2-1-1 is free; choose a language and Option 2 for benefits help. Eligibility is not guaranteed.
entries.how_to_access: Call 2-1-1 or 877-541-7905, or apply online. Ask The Bridge for benefits assistance if you need help with the application.

entries.title: Workforce Solutions Greater Dallas — Opportunity Center
entries.description: Free job-search help, career counseling, access to computers and phones, training information, and referrals to job openings.
entries.address: 1610 S. Malcolm X Boulevard, Dallas, TX 75226
entries.how_to_access: Walk in or call. Bring identification and work history if available, but ask staff what alternatives are accepted.

entries.title: Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas — Dallas
entries.description: Free civil legal help for eligible low-income people, including housing, eviction, public benefits, family law, consumer, employment, and driver-license matters. Help depends on eligibility, priorities, and capacity.
entries.how_to_access: Call or apply online. An application does not guarantee representation.

entries.title: The Stewpot — ID and vital records
entries.description: Helps eligible people obtain a Texas ID, birth certificate, marriage license, school records, or other vital records. A referral letter from a shelter or qualifying agency is required. Services are for people sleeping outside or in an emergency shelter.
entries.address: 1610 S. Malcolm X Boulevard, Dallas, TX 75226
entries.how_to_access: Bring a referral letter. Ask a shelter or case manager to refer you.

entries.title: The Stewpot — mailing address
entries.description: Provides a mailing address for eligible unsheltered people. Shelter residents must bring a referral letter from the shelter. Eligibility rules exclude some other living situations.
entries.address: 1610 S. Malcolm X Boulevard, Dallas, TX 75226
entries.hours: Sign-up Monday–Thursday, 8:00 AM–3:00 PM; pickup times listed on the official page
entries.how_to_access: Bring a referral letter from a shelter or qualifying agency.

entries.title: The Bridge — storage
entries.description: Storage is available as part of The Bridge's free services for homeless adults. Space and rules can change.
entries.how_to_access: Complete intake and ask about current storage limits.

entries.title: The Family Place — domestic and family violence
entries.description: Free, confidential 24-hour crisis hotline, emergency shelter, safety planning, legal advocacy, counseling, and transportation to shelter for survivors of domestic or family violence. Services are available in English and Spanish. Shelter locations are confidential.
entries.how_to_access: Call from a safe place if possible. In immediate danger, call 911.

entries.title: National Call Center for Homeless Veterans
entries.description: Free, confidential help for veterans who are homeless or at risk, and for people calling on their behalf. Connects callers to local VA housing, health care, and other services.
entries.how_to_access: Call or use the official online chat. In immediate danger, call 911.

entries.title: The Bridge — canine kennel
entries.description: On-site kennel for guests' dogs, with food, shelter, and veterinary services. The official site lists 16 spaces, so availability is limited.
entries.how_to_access: Call guest intake at 214-670-1507 before traveling with a dog and ask about space and requirements.

entries.title: Dallas 311
entries.description: City non-emergency service line. It can connect people to homelessness outreach and city services. Outside Dallas dialing area, call 214-670-3111. A request does not guarantee immediate outreach or shelter.
entries.how_to_access: For shelter and housing resources, also call the Housing Forward Crisis Helpline at 888-411-6802.
